findings.title: Reader thread in `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti` is not joined and can leak on failure
findings.body: In `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti`, the background thread started on line 139 is never joined before asserting `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())` on line 157. If a `managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...)` request is still in flight when `deletedAll.set(true)` is called, any exception it throws will be added to `caughtExceptions` after the assertion has already passed, and the request can overlap with subsequent tests sharing `managedRealm`. Additionally, because `deletedAll.set(true)` on line 155 is not in a `finally` block, an exception thrown while deleting groups in lines 152-154 will leave the background thread spinning in `while (!deletedAll.get())` for the remainder of the test suite run. Set `deletedAll.set(true)` in a `finally` block and `join()` the reader thread before asserting on `caughtExceptions`.
